set.name: Criteria for Similar Triangles

criteria: 能用性质求周长与面积
set.description: 相似三角形对应角相等、对应边成比例，对应高、中线、角平分线之比及周长之比等于相似比，面积之比等于相似比的平方。
set.name: Properties of Similar Triangles

set.name: Proportional Line Segments

能说出坐标等于终点坐标减起点坐标
set.description: 会在平面直角坐标系里用起点和终点的坐标表示向量。
set.name: Coordinate Representation of Vectors

set.description: 知道 a·b=|a||b|cosθ，也会用坐标计算 x1x2+y1y2。
set.name: Vector Dot Product

criteria: Use the Pythagorean formula to calculate magnitude.
For nonzero vectors, use a zero dot product to test perpendicularity.
set.description: Compute vector magnitude from coordinates. For two nonzero vectors, zero dot product is equivalent to perpendicular directions. The zero vector has no defined direction or included angle.
set.name: Vector Magnitudes and Angles

set.reason: The endpoint of a median is the side midpoint; midpoint and equal half-length meanings are essential.
set.scope: locating the midpoint of the opposite side

set.reason: Subsidiary triangle similarity proves height/median ratios; direct property use is a different route.
set.scope: proving ratios of heights, medians, bisectors

set.reason: The zero-dot-product perpendicularity criterion explicitly uses dot products.
set.scope: perpendicularity test via zero dot product

set.reason: The 2:1 ratio is measured along medians, and the area relations extend the fact that a median halves the area. The median concept is therefore indispensable here.
set.scope: median definition and median-split equal areas

criteria: 知道中线平分三角形面积
set.description: 连接顶点与对边中点的线段叫中线，三条中线交于重心，一条中线把三角形分成面积相等的两部分。
set.name: Medians of a triangle

criteria: 能用中点性质计算线段长度
set.description: 用度量或叠合比较线段长短，掌握线段的和差与中点概念。
set.name: Comparing and Calculating with Line Segments

criteria: 能说明垂直的定义和符号
能用三角尺过一点作垂线
set.description: 两条直线相交成直角叫互相垂直，其中一条叫另一条的垂线，掌握过一点作已知直线垂线的方法及其唯一性。
set.name: Perpendicular lines

criteria: 能进行含根号的混合运算
set.description: 有理数的运算法则和运算律在实数范围内仍适用，会进行含根号的简单运算。
set.name: Operations with Real Numbers

criteria: Justify area ratios using common bases or heights.
set.description: The three medians meet at the centroid, dividing each median 2:1 from its vertex; use the resulting coordinate and equal-area relations.
set.name: Centroid ratios and median area relations
